claims.claim: RuntimeLab builds from the read-only supplied debug/battle-map derivative with current Vibe Kernel and CMLib sources, without a CMRE map, mission, commander, or CMRE package dependency.
CMLibControl.SC2Map is a current-source CMLib self-test control with no Kernel or RuntimeLab code and only the Void campaign dependency.

The generated RuntimeLab map has a map-local dispatch fixture that consumes the Kernel arg_value wire key, P1/P2 GalaxyVibe BankList, and deterministic Marine/Marauder-versus-Zergling tactical fixture.

An arena-base Kernel control window reached CreateGame and JoinGame, observed a player-1 Ghost, and passed its raw assertion with zero same-window ScriptErrors. It proves that the arena derivative can host the Kernel, but not the current RuntimeLab map SHA.

A pre-current-fix RuntimeLab window observed Ghost=1, a successful system.ping response, kernel_initialized=1, register_entrypoints_done=1, and CMLib Bank magic 13371337. The same window recorded CMLib 623/624 with ai.state.read failing and generated_invoke_disabled for function.invoke, so it is historical diagnostic evidence only.

The current RuntimeLab SHA reached an attributable API window: Kernel transport, system.ping, unit.spawn observation/query agreement, map-local function.invoke clamp, tactical readiness, and the same-window ScriptError gate all passed.
